forecast_read.section8: every forecast read at story time j - 2 - 5 s; the lag moves only the regressors (section 8 and Alice)

lines: On another public story, outside TRIBE v2's training and evaluation sets (Paranoia, Finn et al. 2018; 22 listeners, the whole story: 1,250 volumes = 20.8 minutes at TR 1 s), stock TRIBE v2's forecast tracked the listeners' language areas (z 0.84, p = 0.00013), but at its lower bound it was worth less than one real volunteer (about 0 at the point estimate). It reached 12% of what the other listeners' average reaches.
What it had to beat: word rate and the sound envelope (beaten in 1 of 4 comparisons).
